calculation.expression: on dates where lagged VIX daily change exceeds its prior 60-day 75th percentile: cross_sectional_demean(-sum(return,3))
calculation.description: Fades each tradable asset's lagged three-day return after an elevated VIX shock. The VIX condition is shifted one session to ensure the signal uses only completed information; cross-sectional demeaning removes the common market component.

validation.regime_notes: Conditional sample is sparse; daily IC/ICIR pass the benchmark gates. Daily IC was negative in 2020-22 (-0.0362) and positive in 2023-24 (+0.0933), 2025-26 (+0.0824), and the limited 2027 sample (+0.1138). Use conservatively and revalidate quarterly.
